# spc-lyfja (PHAROS fixture)

Lyfjastofnun, Sérlyfjaskrá, saved 7 November 2026.

* `atc_C07AG.json`: `https://www.serlyfjaskra.is/api/searchMedicineWithAtc?query=C07AG*` (Trandate, labetalol,
  and Carvedilol STADA in four strengths sharing one SmPC).
* `atc_N02BE_excerpt.json`: seven of the medicines `…?query=N02BE*` answers: Paracetamol Medical Valley (two
  strengths, one SmPC), Panodil Extra (paracetamol and caffeine, N02BE51), Panodil (two) and Paracet (Heilsa)
  (two parallel imports).
* `atc_C01EB.json`: `…?query=C01EB*`, every medicine centrally authorised (Procoralan, Camzyos, Beyonttra).
* `Carvedilol_STADA-SmPC.pdf`: `https://www.serlyfjaskra.is/FileRepos/562fdb14-7d21-ea11-80fb-00155d15460a/Carvedilol_STADA-SmPC.pdf`,
  section 10 dated "27. febrúar 2020".
